title: tigridia longispatha
intro: Tigridia longispatha, commonly known as the Mexican daffodil or tiger flower, is a type of flowering plant in the Iridaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tigridia longispatha include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of this plant, including alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
